original_ai_output.title_zh: 科吉州一名警察涉嫌枪杀女同事后自杀，警方启动调查
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚科吉州警察司令部已就一起事件展开调查：警员Amos Yusuf被指在Ajaokuta的ASCO营地枪杀女同事Grace Onimisi后开枪自杀。两人被送往不同医疗机构后均被确认死亡，遗体已存放于ASCO医院太平间。该事件由Ajaokuta分区警官于当晚11时04分上报。目前信息来自单一来源，相关指控尚未经独立证实。

key_facts.fact: 科吉州警察司令部已就一名警员涉嫌枪杀女同事后自杀的事件展开调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kogi State Police Command has commenced an investigation after a police corporal, Amos Yusuf, allegedly shot dead his female colleague, Woman Corporal Grace Onimisi, before shooting himself at the Ajaokuta ASCO Camp

key_facts.fact: 事件由Ajaokuta分区警官于当晚11时04分上报
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident was reported at 11:04pm by the Divisional Police Officer, Ajaokuta

key_facts.fact: 两名警员被送往不同医疗机构后均被确认死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Both officers were taken to separate medical facilities, where they were confirmed dead by medical personnel

key_facts.fact: 两人遗体已存放于ASCO医院太平间
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Their remains have been deposited at the mortuary of ASCO Hospital

uncertainties: 枪杀及自杀行为目前为“据称”（allegedly），尚未经独立证实
事件动机与具体经过尚不清楚
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
